description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'Animation2' that demonstrates changing view animations in a ViewFlipper widget based on user selection from a Spinner. It sets up animations, handles user input, and switches between different animation effects.

classes.name: Animation2
classes.description: An Android activity that showcases different view animations on a ViewFlipper, controlled via a Spinner widget.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, ViewFlipper, and Spinner, and starts automatic flipping of views.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection from the Spinner, changing the flip animations accordingly.

methods.description: No operation; required by interface but unused.
